concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-issuing-authorisation-transaction-rules-examples]] — 2022-modified, 2026-09-15-captured illustrative Issuing rule payloads for channel, MCC/country, velocity, scoped limits and scores; time-window prose/JSON differ and some payloads are incomplete.
warnings: Scoring time prose says 11:00-18:00 Europe/Amsterdam while example JSON says 10:00-17:00 +01:00.
Balance-account daily-limit JSON is structurally incomplete, and the ATM decline example omits outcomeType.
General and creation guides disagree on all-versus-any condition matching; examples do not resolve it.
